# Close CRM | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| One sentence | Sales CRM centred on telephone, text message, mail and external call execution, with Chloe AI sales agent. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competing boundary | There are significant differences in availability and compliance in the telephone/SMS area; TCO changes in communications and AI usage; complex marketing automation and after-sales services require external tools. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | Telephone/SMS regional availability and compliance varies significantly; communication and AI usage changes TCO; complex marketing automation and after-sales services require external tools. |
